summary: Cheniere Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting two credit facility amendments. The CEI Revolving Credit Facility increased commitments by $500 million to $1.75 billion and extended maturity by one year to 2031. Separately, the CCH Revolving Credit Agreement was amended to reduce committed amount by $500 million to $1.0 billion. These are routine refinancing and liquidity-management actions, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved. The filing solely reflects changes to existing credit agreements for general corporate purposes.
